verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API is documented and explicitly covers Spend & Expense (transactions, expenses) alongside AP/AR, with a sandbox, webhooks, and REST endpoints (e.g., vendor CRUD) demonstrated in docs. However, the evidence never mentions OAuth or scoped token authentication — only an 'apiToken' concept appears — and no openapi/swagger spec was found at standard locations, leaving the authentication model underspecified for developers pulling receipts/expense data. Missing for 10: explicit OAuth flow documentation, scoped/permissioned token details, and confirmation of a public OpenAPI spec.
